privacyPolicyComponent.title: Privacy at a glance
privacyPolicyComponent.summary: Files are processed on our servers and never sent to third-party AI providers. Without an account they are kept 24 hours; with a free account you choose 24 hours to 2 years.

consentBanner.label: Cookie and analytics choices
consentBanner.body: We use privacy-respecting, first-party analytics to see which tools get used and where they break. Your files are never part of it, and you can change this any time.
consentBanner.bodyGdpr: Before we measure anything, we need your say-so. We use first-party analytics to see which tools get used and where they break — nothing is collected until you choose, and your files are never part of it.

consentPrefs.title: Privacy preferences
consentPrefs.subtitle: Choose what Media Manipulator may measure. Changes apply immediately after you save.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.body: Your theme choice, and an anonymous device and visit ID that lets us enforce free-tier limits and block abuse. No cookies, no advertising use, and it cannot be turned off without breaking the tools.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Which tools you use, whether a conversion succeeded, how fast pages load, and errors we should fix. First-party, kept 13 months, never sold. No filenames and no file contents.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.body: For personalised advertising. We do not currently show ads, so this does nothing yet — it is listed here so you can see it before it ever becomes active.
advertising.bodyGpc: For personalised advertising. Your browser is sending a Global Privacy Control signal, so this stays off — we honour that signal and a click here cannot override it.

consentPrefs.gpcDetected: Global Privacy Control detected. We have automatically opted you out of any sale or sharing of your personal information, and recorded that we did.

doNotSell.title: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information
doNotSell.body: We do not sell your personal information. This opts you out of any sharing for advertising purposes, now and in future. First-party analytics is a separate choice above.

yourData.title: Your data
yourData.body: Download a copy of everything our analytics holds about this browser, or delete it permanently. If you are signed in, both cover every device linked to your account; otherwise they cover this browser only.
yourData.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your analytics history — events, visits, and your visitor profile — and cannot be undone. Records of your consent choices are kept, as the law requires us to be able to prove them. Type DELETE to confirm.
yourData.deletedSummary: Done. We deleted {{events}} events across {{sessions}} visits, and this browser has been given a brand-new anonymous ID.
yourData.deletedNote: Records of your consent choices are retained as legally required proof. Your consent setting itself is unchanged — if analytics is on, new activity is collected under the new ID; you can turn it off above at any time.
yourData.error: That didn't work. Please try again in a moment — nothing was changed if you saw no confirmation.
